new_finding.title: Existing authorized Bilibili write path has no quota/cooldown
facts: V2 has only MAX_ATTEMPTS=3 and exponential retry backoff for deliveries
the only cooldown in the delivery layer is QQ-specific (qq_bindings.cooldown_s / qq_send_after)
Bilibili read and write have zero rate limits (no 600/h read, 12/h write, 120s cooldown, share <=3/day, comment 30-day, fav 3-day windows)
K18 audit wording 'shared quota/cooldown' is therefore inaccurate and is corrected in the audit addendum
new_finding.impact: the objective requires authorized write paths to cover quota; comment/private_message currently covers approval/dedup/unknown/recovery but not quota. Any autonomous behaviour batch (D5/D6) would need a hard quota before wiring
